about: Every statewide ballot measure New York voters decided from 1894, the year of the Greater New York consolidation vote, through 2025, with statewide yes and no votes; the 1894 consolidation referendum by county and town; New York City and borough results where the NYC Board of Elections publishes them (2005 to 2025); and New York City charter questions, with results from 2010 on and outcomes for the earlier ones found so far. Greater New York took effect January 1, 1898; its first election was November 2, 1897, and neither 1897 nor 1898 had a statewide measure. 2026 city questions carry unofficial election night counts.
